purification_method: template removal: washed with 10% HF for 24 h, then refluxed in HCl at 60 °C for 6 h, washed with water, air-dried at 120 °C (as printed: "10% hydrofluoric acid (HF) for 24 h ... hydrochloric acid at 60 °C for 6 h ... air-dried at 120 °C")
source_location: main article p. 5644 (page image main-6), Figure 5, ZTC8 (open symbols, desorption), point 4 of 7 in the archive
notes: archive: fig5_ZTC8_des.json; branch assigned by the Fig S8 symbol convention (filled = adsorption, empty = desorption); the Fig 5 caption does not define the symbols; figure markers: triangles; centre of a small open-marker interior (1 px); BET range: 0.06-0.22 (P/Po, adsorption data); micropore area and volume by t-plot (Table 1 parentheses); total pore volume at P/Po = 0.99; pore size maxima 0.6/1.2/2.4 nm by NLDFT (no single average stored); degassed 200 °C, 1e-10 bar (1e-5 Pa) for 4-6 h, duration not stored as a range
basis_evidence: "Total hydrogen uptake isotherms of Pd-free (ZTC8) and Pd-loaded carbons" (Fig 5 caption); the excess uptake of the same samples is reported side by side ("Excess hydrogen uptake capacity (at 77K and 20 bar)", SI Table S1)
free_volume_calibration: buoyancy correction using carbon density and hydrogen density (IGA)

purification_method: template removal: washed with 10% HF for 24 h, then refluxed in HCl at 60 °C for 6 h, washed with water, air-dried at 120 °C (as printed: "10% hydrofluoric acid (HF) for 24 h ... hydrochloric acid at 60 °C for 6 h ... air-dried at 120 °C")
source_location: SI p. [10] (page image si1-10), Figure S6, ZTC8Pd-0.2 (open symbols, desorption), point 10 of 18 in the archive
notes: archive: figS6_ZTC8Pd-0.2_des.json; branch assigned by the Fig S8 symbol convention (filled = adsorption, empty = desorption); the Fig S6 caption does not define the symbols; figure markers: inverted triangles; BET range: 0.06-0.22 (P/Po, adsorption data); micropore area and volume by t-plot (Table 1 parentheses); total pore volume at P/Po = 0.99; pore size maxima 0.6/1.2/2.4 nm by NLDFT (no single average stored); degassed 200 °C, 1e-10 bar (1e-5 Pa) for 4-6 h, duration not stored as a range; Pd loading by XRF
basis_evidence: "Excess hydrogen uptake isotherms of Pd-free (ZTC8) and Pd-loaded carbons" (Fig S6 caption); the total uptake of the same samples is reported side by side (Table 1, Fig 5, "total hydrogen uptake")
free_volume_calibration: buoyancy correction using carbon density and hydrogen density (IGA)
